words.meaning: Mara li għandha jew trabbi wild.
words.exampleEnglish: My mother prepares food for the family.

words.meaning: Raġel li għandu jew irabbi wild.
words.exampleEnglish: My father works in the garden.

words.meaning: Tifel jew raġel li għandu l-istess ġenituri tiegħek.

words.meaning: Tifla jew mara li għandha l-istess ġenituri tiegħek.
words.exampleEnglish: My sister reads a book in the room.

words.meaning: Tifel jew raġel fir-rabta tiegħu mal-ġenituri.
words.exampleEnglish: Their son goes to school every day.

words.meaning: Tifla jew mara fir-rabta tagħha mal-ġenituri.
words.exampleEnglish: Their daughter likes playing the piano.

words.meaning: Omm wieħed mill-ġenituri tiegħek.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandmother told me an old story.

words.meaning: Missier wieħed mill-ġenituri tiegħek.
words.exampleEnglish: Grandfather walks to the shop every morning.

words.meaning: Il-parti ta’ fuq tal-ġisem li fiha l-moħħ, l-għajnejn u l-wiċċ.
words.exampleEnglish: He put a hat on his head.

words.meaning: Il-parti fit-tarf tad-driegħ li għandha s-swaba’.
words.exampleEnglish: She wrote her name with her right hand.

words.meaning: Il-parti tal-ġisem li tintuża biex toqgħod bilwieqfa u timxi.
words.exampleEnglish: He injured his leg during the game.

words.meaning: L-organu tal-ġisem li bih tara.
words.exampleEnglish: A speck of dust went into her eye.

words.meaning: L-organu fuq kull naħa tar-ras li bih tisma’.
words.exampleEnglish: She heard a loud sound with her ears.

words.meaning: Il-parti tal-wiċċ li tintuża biex tiekol, tixrob u titkellem.
words.exampleEnglish: He opened his mouth to speak.

words.meaning: Il-parti tal-wiċċ li biha tieħu n-nifs u xxomm.
words.exampleEnglish: He smelled the flower with his nose.

words.meaning: Bini fejn jgħixu persuna jew familja.
words.exampleEnglish: Their house has a small garden.

words.meaning: Biċċa li tinfetaħ u tingħalaq biex tidħol jew toħroġ minn post.
words.exampleEnglish: Close the door before you leave.

words.meaning: Fetħa bil-ħġieġ f’ħajt li ddaħħal id-dawl u l-arja.
words.exampleEnglish: She opened the window to let in some air.

words.meaning: Għamara b’wiċċ ċatt u saqajn li tintuża biex tqiegħed affarijiet fuqha.

words.meaning: Għamara b’sedil u dahar magħmula biex persuna tpoġġi bilqiegħda.
words.exampleEnglish: He sat down on the chair.

words.meaning: Għamara magħmula biex persuna timtedd u torqod fuqha.
words.exampleEnglish: The boy went to bed early.

words.meaning: Parti magħluqa minn bini, mifruda b’ħitan u bieb.
words.exampleEnglish: The bedroom is upstairs.

words.meaning: Kamra fejn jitħejja u jissajjar l-ikel.
words.exampleEnglish: She is preparing the meal in the kitchen.

words.meaning: Il-parti ta’ barra fil-quċċata ta’ bini li tipproteġih mix-xita u x-xemx.
words.exampleEnglish: The pigeon landed on the roof.

words.meaning: Il-wiċċ ta’ fuq minn ġewwa ta’ kamra.
words.exampleEnglish: The lamp is attached to the ceiling.

words.meaning: Struttura wieqfa li tagħlaq jew tifred spazju minn ieħor.
words.exampleEnglish: They hung the picture on the wall.

words.meaning: Serje ta’ turġien li tintuża biex titla’ jew tinżel bejn livelli.
words.exampleEnglish: He went up the stairs slowly.

words.meaning: Oġġett żgħir li jintuża biex jinfetaħ jew jingħalaq serratura.
words.exampleEnglish: He opened the door with the key.

words.meaning: Mgħarfa żgħira li tintuża għat-te, il-kafè jew ammonti żgħar ta’ ikel.
words.exampleEnglish: Stir the coffee with the teaspoon.

words.meaning: Kontenitur żgħir, ħafna drabi b’manku, li minnu jinxtorbu xarbiet.
words.exampleEnglish: She drank a cup of hot tea.

words.meaning: L-istilla li tagħti dawl u sħana lid-Dinja.
words.exampleEnglish: The sun rose early this morning.

words.meaning: Il-ġisem naturali li jdur mad-Dinja u jidher l-aktar billejl.
words.exampleEnglish: The moon was full and bright.

words.meaning: Ġisem kbir u jaħraq fl-ispazju li jidher bħala punt ta’ dawl fis-sema.
words.exampleEnglish: We saw a bright star in the sky.

words.meaning: L-ispazju li jidher fuq l-art u fejn naraw is-sħab, ix-xemx u l-kwiekeb.
words.exampleEnglish: The sky was clear and blue.

clues.easy: Jidher fis-sema u jista’ jġib ix-xita

words.meaning: Massa ta’ qtar żgħir tal-ilma jew kristalli tas-silġ fl-atmosfera.
words.exampleEnglish: A dark cloud passed over the village.

words.meaning: Qtar tal-ilma li jaqa’ mis-sħab lejn l-art.
words.exampleEnglish: The rain watered the garden.

words.meaning: Arja li tiċċaqlaq minn post għal ieħor.
words.exampleEnglish: The wind moved the tree branches.

words.meaning: Kristalli bojod tas-silġ li jaqgħu mis-sħab meta jkun kiesaħ ħafna.
words.exampleEnglish: The snow covered the road in white.

words.meaning: Ilma li jkun inbidel f’solidu minħabba temperatura baxxa.
words.exampleEnglish: He put some ice in the drink.

words.meaning: Sħaba baxxa qrib l-art li tagħmilha diffiċli biex tara ’l bogħod.
words.exampleEnglish: The fog covered the road in the morning.

words.meaning: Qtar żgħir tal-ilma li jinġabar fuq uċuħ kesħin, l-aktar filgħodu.
words.exampleEnglish: The dew shines on the grass.

words.meaning: Firxa kbira ta’ ilma mielaħ, iżgħar minn oċean jew parti minnu.
words.exampleEnglish: The sea was calm and clear.

words.meaning: Nixxiegħa kbira ta’ ilma li timxi lejn baħar, lag jew xmara oħra.
words.exampleEnglish: The river flows between two villages.

words.meaning: Medda ta’ art baxxa bejn għoljiet jew muntanji, kultant b’ilma jgħaddi minnha.
words.exampleEnglish: We walked through the valley after the rain.

clues.easy: Medda żgħira ta’ ilma mdawra bl-art

words.meaning: Medda żgħira ta’ ilma wieqaf imdawra bl-art.
words.exampleEnglish: The ducks were swimming in the pond.

words.meaning: Pjanta kbira b’zokk tal-injam, friegħi u weraq.
words.exampleEnglish: The tree gives us shade in summer.

words.meaning: Parti ċatta u normalment ħadra li tikber fuq zokk jew fergħa ta’ pjanta.
words.exampleEnglish: A leaf fell from the tree.

words.meaning: Il-parti ta’ pjanta li ħafna drabi tkun ikkulurita u tipproduċi ż-żerriegħa.
words.exampleEnglish: The flower opened in spring.

words.meaning: Pjanti rqaq u ħodor li jikbru qrib l-art.
words.exampleEnglish: The grass grew after the rain.

words.meaning: Biċċa iebsa ta’ materjal naturali li tifforma parti mill-art.
words.exampleEnglish: She found a smooth stone by the shore.

words.meaning: Annimal domestiku magħruf għal-lealtà tiegħu u għall-ħoss tal-inbiħ.
words.exampleEnglish: The dog is playing with the ball.

words.meaning: Annimal domestiku żgħir b’suf artab, dwiefer u mustaċċi.
words.exampleEnglish: The cat is sleeping on the chair.

words.meaning: Annimal żgħir b’denb twil li spiss jgħix qrib in-nies.
words.exampleEnglish: The mouse entered through a small hole.

clues.easy: Annimal kbir li wieħed jista’ jirkeb

words.meaning: Annimal kbir u b’saħħtu b’erba’ saqajn li jista’ jintuża għall-irkib jew ix-xogħol.

words.meaning: Annimal kbir tar-razzett li jitkabbar għall-ħalib jew il-laħam.

words.meaning: Annimal tar-razzett b’qrun li jitkabbar għall-ħalib, il-laħam jew is-suf.

words.meaning: Annimal tar-razzett b’suf oħxon li jitkabbar għas-suf, il-ħalib jew il-laħam.

words.meaning: Annimal żgħir b’widnejn twal u saqajn ta’ wara b’saħħithom.

words.meaning: Annimal bil-ġwienaħ, ir-rix u munqar; ħafna għasafar jistgħu jtiru.

words.meaning: Annimal li jgħix fl-ilma, jieħu n-nifs bil-garġi u normalment għandu xewk.

words.meaning: Insett li jtir, jiġbor in-nektar mill-fjuri u jgħix f’kolonja.

words.meaning: Insett żgħir li jgħix f’kolonji organizzati u spiss iġorr ikel lejn il-bejta.

words.meaning: Għasfur domestiku femminili li jitkabbar l-aktar għall-bajd.

words.meaning: Annimal tar-razzett b’ġisem tqil, saqajn qosra u geddum ċatt.

words.meaning: Ikel moħmi magħmul prinċipalment mid-dqiq, l-ilma u l-ħmira.

words.meaning: Likwidu ċar u essenzjali għall-ħajja li nixorbu u nużaw kuljum.

words.meaning: Sustanza kristallina użata biex tagħti togħma lill-ikel jew tippreservah.

words.meaning: Ikel ovali b’qoxra li normalment jiġi mit-tiġieġ u jista’ jissajjar b’ħafna modi.

words.meaning: Ikel magħmul mid-dqiq u l-ilma, bħal spagetti, imqarrun jew penne.

words.meaning: Ħaxixa li tikber taħt l-art u tista’ tissajjar b’ħafna modi.

words.meaning: Frotta ħamra u mmerraq li tintuża ħafna fl-insalati u fit-tisjir.

words.meaning: Frotta taċ-ċitru safra b’meraq qares u riħa qawwija.

words.meaning: Frotta żgħira ħamra biż-żerriegħa fuq barra u togħma ħelwa.

words.meaning: Frott żgħir u tond li jikber f’għenieqed u jista’ jkun aħdar, aħmar jew iswed.

words.meaning: Sustanza ħelwa u ħoxna li n-naħal jagħmel min-nektar tal-fjuri.

words.meaning: Post fejn l-istudenti jmorru biex jitgħallmu taħt il-gwida tal-għalliema.

words.meaning: Post fejn jinbiegħu oġġetti jew jingħataw servizzi lill-klijenti.

words.meaning: Bini Nisrani użat għat-talb, il-qima u ċ-ċelebrazzjonijiet reliġjużi.
